title: 第11章 师尊 被你欺负一下没什么的第12章 给我跪着说话
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
“你们两个有完没完，只不过是双修而已，用得着这样吗？”
小妖女面红耳赤，在一旁恼怒的说道。
只见周通上身赤裸，慕容雅双手按在了他的后背上，将一缕缕红色的灵气渡给了他。
“砰砰砰砰…”
周通的体内传出了异响，紧接着身上就有血红色的纹路浮现，像是一道道的枷锁，最终汇聚在他的心脏处。
“这是…房中术的合欢锁！”
周通睁开眼睛，看着身上红色的纹路，只觉得其中流淌着不可思议的力量。
“没错，合欢锁可以支配一切，如果精神力足够强大，就连天道都能支配……呃！”
话还没有说完，慕容雅的气质就发生了翻天覆地的变化。
“不好，师尊的玉魔体犯了！”
小妖女惊呼道，玉魔体是合欢天功的特殊秘法，进入这种状态后，将会变得极其危险。
“师尊，你冷静一些！”
“快，用合欢锁，锁住我！快！。”
看到慕容雅强行让自己冷静下来的样子，周通一咬牙，总算是下定了决心！
“合欢锁，给我反攻！”
刹那间攻守互换，枷锁缠住了慕容雅，而后融入了对方体内。
“呃…”
这一刻，周通能清楚的感受到慕容雅的生命律动，就连对方心跳的节奏都能轻松把握。
催动之后，很快，慕容雅就缓和了过来。
“小家伙……”

“师尊，对不起，这合欢锁……”
“无妨，本就是应急之事，如此这般……也还算好。”
慕容雅望着周通略有汗滴的胸肌，咽了口唾沫后，眼中精光一闪，身子一软，直接扑倒在了周通的怀中。
“啊！”
当触摸到周通的胸肌，慕容雅顿时只感觉心头某个地方得到了满足。
自己啥时候吃过这么好的？！
香软入怀，周通顿时心跳加速。
同时，他也感觉到，他的身体又发生了变化，修为飞速猛长。
先天九重境瞬间突破，踏入了分魂境界，而且一路高歌，最终抵达分魂九重境！
房中术，恐怖如斯！
“师尊，请自重！”
经过周通提醒，慕容雅也反应过来自己的不对，轻轻撑起身子，有些不舍地看着周通的胸肌，摆手道。
“为师累了，月儿，你就带小家伙去挑选洞府吧。”
慕容雅媚眼如丝，香汗淋漓的说道，看样子是真的困乏了。
“跟我来吧，坏蛋！”
content_en:
"Whether you two are done or not, you are just practicing dual cultivation. Is there any need for this?"
The little demon girl blushed and said angrily from the side.
Zhou Tong was seen naked from the waist up, and Murong Ya put her hands on his back and transferred wisps of red spiritual energy to him.
"Bang bang bang bang..."
There was a strange sound in Zhou Tong's body, and then blood-red lines appeared on his body, like shackles, finally converging on his heart.
"This is... the Acacia Lock of Fangzhongshu!"
Zhou Tong opened his eyes and looked at the red lines on his body, feeling that there was incredible power flowing in them.
"That's right, Albizia Lock can control everything. If the mental power is strong enough, even the way of heaven can be controlled... ugh!"
Before she finished speaking, Murong Ya's temperament changed drastically.
"No, Master's Jade Demonic Body has violated it!"
The little demon girl exclaimed that the Jade Demonic Body is a special secret method of Hehuan Tian Gong. After entering this state, it will become extremely dangerous.
"Master, calm down!"
"Quick, lock me with the acacia lock! Quick!"
Seeing Murong Ya forcing herself to calm down, Zhou Tong gritted his teeth and finally made up his mind!
"Albizia Locks, counterattack!"
In an instant, offense and defense exchanged, and the shackles wrapped around Murong Ya, and then merged into the opponent's body.
"Uh..."
At this moment, Zhou Tong could clearly feel the rhythm of Murong Ya's life, and could even easily grasp the rhythm of her heartbeat.
After being stimulated, Murong Ya soon calmed down.
"Little guy..."
"Master, I'm sorry, this acacia lock..."
"It doesn't matter, it's just an emergency, so...it's not bad."
Murong Ya looked at Zhou Tong's slightly sweaty chest muscles. After swallowing, her eyes flashed, her body softened, and she fell directly into Zhou Tong's arms.
"Ah!"
When Murong Yadun touched Zhou Tong's chest muscles, she just felt satisfied somewhere in her heart.
When have you ever had such good food? !
The fragrance was soft in his arms, and Zhou Tong's heartbeat suddenly accelerated.
At the same time, he also felt that his body had changed again, and his cultivation level had grown rapidly.
He broke through the ninth level of Xiantian in an instant and entered the realm of divided souls. He sang loudly all the way and finally reached the ninth level of divided souls!
The magic in the room is so terrifying!
"Master, please respect yourself!"
After Zhou Tong reminded her, Murong Ya also realized that she was wrong, gently propped herself up, looked at Zhou Tong's chest muscles with some reluctance, and waved her hands.
"I'm tired of being a teacher, Yue'er, just take the little one to choose a cave."
Murong Ya's charming eyes were as silk as silk, and she said dripping with sweat. It looked like she was really sleepy.
"Come with me, you bad guy!"
